tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend enrichment (passages + toc)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** list_book_passages returns preview, chapter_id, link_count; book_toc returns first_block_id.

**Files:** Modify backend/folio_backend/app.py (list_book_passages + book_toc), models.py (ChapterOut.first_block_id); Create backend/tests/test_notes_page_enrichment.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- each passage from GET /books/{id}/passages has preview (start-block text from start_off, <=200 chars), chapter_id (start block's chapter), link_count
- each chapter from GET /books/{id}/toc has first_block_id (first block by order_idx, or null)
- existing suite passes

**Verify:** nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 websockets ])' --run 'python -m unittest tests.test_notes_page_enrichment -v && python -m unittest discover -s tests' -> OK

**Steps:** TDD — write test (create book/chapter/block/passages/link via store; assert enriched fields; confirm store.create_passage/link_passages signatures); confirm fail; add ChapterOut.first_block_id; add first_block_id subquery to book_toc (preserve 404); enrich each passage in list_book_passages with chapter_id/preview(slice start_off:+200)/link_count (COUNT passage_links from OR to); confirm pass + full suite (include websockets in shell — terminal-proxy tests live on this branch); commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Frontend Notes page overhaul
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite NotesView into tabbed (Summaries/Notes), searchable, tag-filtered, chapter-grouped view fed by the enriched endpoints (no getBlocks/getLinks). Summaries tab shows book summary + only chapters with a summary + add-to-chapter picker. Reuse workstream A's SummaryEditor.

**Files:** Modify frontend/src/api/client.ts (PassageDetail += preview/chapter_id/link_count; Chapter += first_block_id), src/notesview/NotesView.tsx (rewrite main component, keep SummaryEditor), src/notesview/NotesView.test.tsx (rewrite), src/notesview/NotesView.module.css (add classes); Create src/notesview/fuzzy.ts + fuzzy.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- load() calls only getToc/listPassages/listBookSummaries (never getBlocks; no per-passage getLinks)
- tabs switch Summaries/Notes (default Notes)
- fuzzy search narrows rows; multi-select tag picker (OR) narrows rows; annotations grouped by chapter
- Summaries tab: book summary + only chapters with a summary + Add-summary-to-chapter select
- A's editing behavior still works (edit in place, agent relabel, add); full frontend suite + npm run build pass

**Verify:** from frontend/: node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/notesview/ then node_modules/.bin/vitest run and npm run build -> all pass

**Steps:** write fuzzy.ts + test; extend client types (regenerate schema via npm run gen-api after Task 1 builds, or intersect first_block_id); rewrite NotesView main component (tabs/search/tag-picker/grouping/summaries-with-content+add-picker), keep SummaryEditor from A, drop unused imports (Block/passageText/Link); add CSS classes (tabs/tab/tabActive/search/group/groupTitle/addChapter/summaryList); rewrite NotesView.test.tsx (mocks without getBlocks/getLinks, enriched passage mocks, tab/search/tagpicker/grouping/summaries-tab/agent-relabel tests); run vitest + full suite + build; commit.
